Knivstikkingen i Bjørvika: Mann etterlyst internasjonalt
items.excerpt: Politiet søker fortsatt etter en navngitt siktet etter knivstikkingen i et parkeringshus i Bjørvika i Oslo lørdag ettermiddag. items.title: Bortetap for Lilleberg og Lightning i Utah

items.title: Prague honours Roma resistance fighters against Hitler
items.excerpt: More than 1,400 Roma fought against the German Nazi occupation in Czechoslovakia. A new exhibition in Prague showcases the stories of partisans and soldiers whose fates barely received any attention for decades.

items.title: Thousands of Northern Irish Protestants march ahead of court ruling

items.title: Saudi Arabia looks to US for an AI edge as Yemen's Houthis up pressure
items.excerpt: The US is helping Saudi Arabia fight the Houthi group in Yemen with AI-assisted targeting. But AI is not a magic bullet, experts say, and there are technological, political and human rights issues to consider.
